prose: The New York Times reports that OpenAI president Greg Brockman told staff in a Slack message he does not plan to give more than his initial $25 million to the super PAC Leading the Future. He called the PAC a 'distraction' for the company. Based on the Techmeme excerpt.
highlights: Brockman will not donate beyond the initial $25M
Calls Leading the Future a 'distraction' at OpenAI
Basis: Techmeme excerpt of the NYT
